title: Source-bound fixed-interval irrigation counter filter

source.equation: For irgdayfix in 1..366: if irrigevent==2 and dayfix>=irgdayfix, preserve the event and set dayfix=1; otherwise cancel irrigevent and increment dayfix only when dayfix<irgdayfix.
source.configuration_guard: The source rejects tcsfix=1 together with tcs=6; this slice isolates only the post-filter.

scope: pure TCSFIX post-filter of an already selected candidate and legacy dayfix counter update
interval equality, event candidate/no-candidate behavior and initial dayfix=366 sentinel
100000 deterministic source comparisons at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
non_goals: daily invocation/calendar proof, candidate timing criteria or irrigation event construction
state owner, persisted/restartable day counter, transaction or event/source booking
pass_conditions: candidate event is accepted iff candidate=true and dayfix>=irgdayfix
accepted event sets dayfix to one
rejected/no-candidate paths follow the source increment guard exactly, including holding counters already at/above threshold
100000 deterministic vectors pass at O0/O2 with transcript identity
